quality_metric_note: low_confidence_rate is a confidence-based proxy calibrated at the 5th percentile on clean validation images; it is not VLM self-report.
method_note: Single-modality CPU reproduction of the artifact-generation and robustness evaluation pipeline. SyntheticXrayLike is simulated data; medmnist mode uses official PneumoniaMNIST. Neither mode reproduces the original VLM models or their numerical results.
